queries:
SELECT c.courseID, c.name AS courseName, u.name AS university, c.credits,
       CASE WHEN c.exam = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS hasExam
FROM courses AS c
JOIN universities AS u ON u.uniID = c.uniID
WHERE c.name LIKE '%' || :keyword || '%'
  AND (:uni_id IS NULL OR c.uniID = :uni_id)
ORDER BY u.name, c.name

SELECT c.courseID, c.name AS courseName, u.name AS university,
       d.name AS department, c.credits
FROM courses AS c
JOIN universities AS u ON u.uniID = c.uniID
JOIN departments AS d ON d.deptID = c.deptID
WHERE c.uniID = :uni_id AND c.deptID = :dept_id
ORDER BY c.name

SELECT c.name AS courseName, o.term, o.day, o.startTime,
       o.endTime, c.credits
FROM courseOfferings AS o
JOIN courses AS c ON c.courseID = o.courseID
WHERE c.uniID = :uni_id
  AND (:term IS NULL OR o.term = :term)
  AND o.day IN ('Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed')
  AND o.startTime >= :earliest_start
ORDER BY o.startTime DESC, o.day, c.name

SELECT c.name AS courseName, o.term, o.day,
       o.startTime, o.endTime, c.credits
FROM courses AS c
JOIN courseOfferings AS o ON o.courseID = c.courseID
WHERE c.uniID = :uni_id
  AND c.exam = 0
  AND o.term = :term
ORDER BY o.day, o.startTime, c.name

SELECT host.name AS hostCourse, u.name AS hostUniversity,
       home.name AS hkuEquivalent,
       host.credits AS hostCredits, home.credits AS hkuCredits
FROM courseEquivalences AS eq
JOIN courses AS home ON home.courseID = eq.homeCourseID
JOIN courses AS host ON host.courseID = eq.hostCourseID
JOIN universities AS u ON u.uniID = host.uniID
WHERE home.uniID = 1 AND host.uniID = :uni_id
ORDER BY host.name, home.name

SELECT t.teacherID, t.name AS teacher, o.term,
       COUNT(*) AS offeringCount
FROM teachers AS t
JOIN courseOfferings AS o ON o.teacherID = t.teacherID
JOIN courses AS c ON c.courseID = o.courseID
WHERE c.uniID = :uni_id AND o.term = :term
GROUP BY t.teacherID, t.name, o.term
ORDER BY offeringCount DESC, t.name

SELECT s.studentID, s.name AS student, o.term,
       COUNT(*) AS classes, SUM(c.credits) AS enrolledCredits,
       s.requiredCredits, ROUND(AVG(e.grade), 1) AS avgGrade,
       CASE WHEN SUM(c.credits) >= s.requiredCredits
            THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS meetsRequirement
FROM enrollments AS e
JOIN students AS s ON s.studentID = e.studentID
JOIN courseOfferings AS o ON o.offeringID = e.offeringID
JOIN courses AS c ON c.courseID = o.courseID
WHERE s.studentID = :student_id
GROUP BY s.studentID, s.name, o.term, s.requiredCredits
ORDER BY o.term

SELECT c.courseID, c.name AS courseName, o.term,
       COUNT(e.grade) AS gradedStudents,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.grade < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedStudents,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.grade < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             / COUNT(e.grade), 1) AS failRatePct
FROM courses AS c
JOIN courseOfferings AS o ON o.courseID = c.courseID
JOIN enrollments AS e ON e.offeringID = o.offeringID
WHERE c.uniID = :uni_id AND o.term = :term
GROUP BY c.courseID, c.name, o.term
HAVING COUNT(e.grade) > 0
ORDER BY failRatePct DESC, gradedStudents DESC, c.name

SELECT c.courseID, c.name AS courseName, u.name AS university
FROM courses c JOIN universities u ON u.uniID = c.uniID
WHERE c.uniID = :uni_id AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM courseEquivalences eq
  JOIN courses h ON h.courseID = eq.homeCourseID
  WHERE eq.hostCourseID = c.courseID AND h.uniID = 1
)
ORDER BY c.name

SELECT c.courseID, c.name AS courseName, o.term,
       COUNT(e.studentID) AS enrolledStudents
FROM courses c JOIN courseOfferings o ON o.courseID = c.courseID
JOIN enrollments e ON e.offeringID = o.offeringID
WHERE c.uniID = :uni_id AND o.term = :term
GROUP BY c.courseID, c.name, o.term
HAVING COUNT(e.studentID) >= :min_enrollments
ORDER BY enrolledStudents DESC, c.name

SELECT b.offeringID, c.name AS conflictingCourse,
       b.term, b.day, b.startTime, b.endTime
FROM courseOfferings a
JOIN courses chosen ON chosen.courseID = a.courseID
JOIN courseOfferings b ON b.offeringID <> a.offeringID
  AND b.term = a.term AND b.day = a.day
  AND a.startTime < b.endTime AND b.startTime < a.endTime
JOIN courses c ON c.courseID = b.courseID
WHERE a.offeringID = :offering_id AND c.uniID = chosen.uniID
ORDER BY b.startTime, c.name
